name: How do I maintain and clean my new backsplash?

mainEntity.name: How do I maintain and clean my new backsplash?

acceptedAnswer.text: Maintaining your new backsplash primarily depends on its material. Generally, regular wiping with a soft cloth and mild, non-abrasive cleaner is sufficient for most tile types. For natural stone backsplashes, it is crucial to use pH-neutral cleaners and re-seal them periodically to protect against staining. During your project's final walkthrough, AKN Design Group provides specific care instructions tailored to the materials selected for your customized renovation, ensuring lasting beauty.
acceptedAnswer.description: Backsplash maintenance varies by material; generally, use mild cleaners and re-seal natural stone as needed.
